item.title: Kopi Luwak by Fragrance World – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Fragrance World
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

A dark, earthy coffee scent from Fragrance World's Coffee Collection, named after the rare civet coffee of Indonesia. Unsweetened roasted coffee opens over a smoky rose heart, then settles into a resinous base of oud, rockrose and patchouli with a faintly animalic edge. Kopi Luwak is an Eau de Parfum for those who like their coffee scents brooding rather than sugary.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Roasted Coffee
Middle: Rose
Base: Oud, Cistus (Rockrose), Patchouli

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, special occasions, evenings

item.title: Ameer by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Maison Asrar
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 21.09 (5 variants)

Overview

Ameer by Maison Asrar is a bright, spicy incense Eau de Parfum. Cardamom, pink pepper, bergamot, saffron and pink grapefruit open fresh and peppery, a heart of frankincense, myrrh, rose, Atlas cedar and lily of the valley turns it resinous and refined, and patchouli, vanilla, moss and musk give it a smooth, long-wearing base. It is an elegant, grown-up scent often compared to Amouage Decision.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Bergamot, Saffron, Pink Grapefruit
Middle: Frankincense, Myrrh, Rose, Atlas Cedarwood, Lily of the Valley
Base: Patchouli, Vanilla, Moss, Musk

Best for

Season: Fall, winter and spring · Wear it: office, date night, special occasions · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Pink Drops by Mykonos – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Mykonos
Type:
Price: 2.99 - 25.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Pink Drops by Mykonos is a creamy, powdery strawberry-milk gourmand Extrait de Parfum. Strawberry jam, caramel and almond open sweet and edible, a soft milky heart of heliotrope and powdery notes follows, and vanilla and white musk leave a cosy, comforting trail. It is the strawberry sister to Mykonos Milk Drops, sweet and playful without being sharp.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Strawberry Jam, Caramel, Almond
Middle: Milk, Powdery Notes, Heliotrope
Base: Vanilla, White Musk

Best for

Season: Fall, winter and spring · Wear it: date night, office, everyday · Performance: moderate, soft and cosy

Overview

Nabatieh by French Avenue is a warm, smoky oriental gourmand Extrait de Parfum. Cardamom, cinnamon and almond open spicy and nutty, a heart of dates, coffee, iris and vanilla brings dark roasted sweetness, and tonka, cedar, Akigalawood and a smoky base give it depth. It is a rich, cosy scent built for cool evenings.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cardamom, Cinnamon, Almond
Middle: Date, Coffee, Iris, Vanilla
Base: Tonka Bean, Cedarwood, Akigalawood, Smoky Notes

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting, strong projection

Overview

Sh'Mallow Fluff by French Avenue is a sugary, playful fruity gourmand Eau de Parfum. Strawberry, apple, lemon and coconut open juicy and bright, a fluffy marshmallow heart is lifted by orange blossom and jasmine, and vanilla, praline and musk give it a soft, sweet finish. It is a fun, candy-sweet scent often compared to Kayali Yum Boujee Marshmallow 81.

Type:

Overview

Craft Stone is a resinous, smoky amber from Jo Milano Paris, an Extrait de Parfum often compared to Amouage Outlands. Frankincense, elemi and cardamom open over lemon, bergamot and Sichuan pepper, before a dark aromatic heart of patchouli, saffron, cumin, anise and wormwood. The drydown is warm and balsamic: oud, vanilla, benzoin, opoponax, labdanum and birch smoke with a sweet maltol glow.

Fragrance Notes

Middle: Patchouli, Anise, Coriander, Saffron, Cumin, Orange Blossom, Wormwood, Geranium, Rose
